basis.text: A receipt is listed as large when it is in the top 0.1% of its own class and at least 20x that class's median counted receipt, which is $10,000.00 or more from an individual and $15,350.60 or more from any other contributor; the 0.1% cut and the 20x multiple are a proposed default and await the owner's ratification.
